turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.

The delivery address can be changed only before the order ships, and staff must approve the change. Please share your order number (SC-####) and the email used for the order, plus the new address you want to use.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

turns.text: The order is SC-3360, the email is nora.blake@example.com, and the new address is Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu.
Your order has already shipped, so a colleague needs to review whether the delivery address can still be changed. They’ll take over from here.

input.summary: Verified order SC-3360. Customer requests delivery address change to Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu. Order has already shipped, so delivery change requires staff decision.
